EuroMillions Lottery Results

As one of the biggest lotteries in the world, the EuroMillions Lottery results are worth your attention. Are you a millionaire? Read on to find out.

The EuroMillions lottery draw happens every Tuesday and Friday at 21:45 Central European Time (CET). Here are the latest results, straight from Paris. You might be celebrating tonight - let's discover if Lady Luck is knocking on your front door!

Are you a Millionaire?

There are a total of 13 prize payout tiers for the EuroMillions lottery. To win the jackpot, you need to match all five main numbers plus the two Lucky Stars numbers. If there are no winners, the jackpot rolls over each week up to a maximum of €200 million.

You don't have to win the jackpot to get lucky. You could win a prize by matching just two main numbers, so be sure to check your ticket carefully.

Here at LottosOnline, we update our players who purchased tickets via email as soon as they have won. So even if you forget to check the EuroMillions lottery results, you won't miss out on any winnings. Good luck!

Draws are conducted every Tuesday and Friday.
